entities.name: Speaker
entities.description: An obsolete creature type for clerics, shamans, druids and wizards who speak to cast magic or commune with creatures; many planes have their own Speakers.

entities.name: Death Speakers
entities.description: A sect of Aysen clerics on Ulgrotha who studied the occult and practiced minor divination and spirit summoning.

entities.name: Serra inquisitors
entities.description: Inquisitors who raided Death Speakers' homes.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Provided black magic books to Death Speakers to sway them to his control.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose nine leaders are Speakers.

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: Prime Speaker, leader of the Simic Combine.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: A Speaker of the Simic Combine.

entities.name: Baru
entities.description: Wurmspeaker, a human druid who speaks to wurms.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: Speaker of Femeref, a cleric from Dominaria ensuring spirits are blessed.

entities.name: Ishai
entities.description: Dragonspeaker, aven monk attendant to the dragon Ojutai.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Dragonspeaker, human former planeswalker who can transform into a dragon.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Worldsoul Speaker, a former planeswalker connecting with her plane's worldsoul.

entities.name: Sutina
entities.description: Elfish leader of the Tajuru known as the Speaker.

entities.name: Garruk
entities.description: Wildspeaker, planeswalker druid who summons beasts.

events.summary: Serra inquisitors raid the Death Speakers' homes, while Baron Sengir offers them black magic books to win control of them.
events.quote: which caused Serra inquisitors to raid their homes

relations.note: tried to sway them to his control with black magic books
relations.quote: Baron Sengir took advantage of this to provide black magic books to some of them to try to sway them to be under his control.
Vannifar , a Prime Speaker or leader of the Simic Combine .
Zegana , a Speaker of the Simic Combine.
Ishai , a Dragonspeaker, an aven monk who is the attendant to the dragon Ojutai .
